blocks.x: Who were the fellows in the Fletcher Henderson band when you joined it?
Sandy Williams, Bobby Stark, Russell Procope, and Clarence Holiday, my best buddy.
He played guitar. Bobby Stark played trumpet. Sandy Williams had to stop drinking. ... He said, "I'm not going to drink any more whiskey."
